--src: Mathlib.Logic.Embedding.Basic
/-- The embedding of `β` into the sum `α ⊕ β`. -/
@[simps]
def inr {α β : Type*} : β ↪ α ⊕ β :=
  ⟨Sum.inr, fun _ _ => Sum.inr.inj⟩

--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Sum
/-- The disjoint sum is associative up to isomorphism. `Iso.sumAssoc` as a graph isomorphism. -/
@[simps!]
def Iso.sumAssoc {I : SimpleGraph γ} : (G ⊕g H) ⊕g I ≃g G ⊕g (H ⊕g I) := ⟨Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ, by
  intro u v
  cases u <;> cases v <;> rename_i u v
  · cases u <;> cases v <;> simp
  · cases u <;> simp
  · cases v <;> simp
  · simp⟩

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Pi.Basic
@[to_additive]
theorem elim_inv_inv [Inv γ] : Sum.elim a⁻¹ b⁻¹ = (Sum.elim a b)⁻¹ :=
  (Sum.comp_elim Inv.inv a b).symm

--src: Mathlib.ModelTheory.Semantics
theorem realize_restrictVarLeft [DecidableEq α] {γ : Type*} {t : L.Term (α ⊕ γ)}
    {f : t.varFinsetLeft → β}
    {xs : β ⊕ γ → M} (xs' : α → M) (hxs' : ∀ a, xs (Sum.inl (f a)) = xs' a) :
    (t.restrictVarLeft f).realize xs = t.realize (Sum.elim xs' (xs ∘ Sum.inr)) := by
  induction t with
  | var a => cases a <;> simp [restrictVarLeft, hxs']
  | func _ _ ih =>
    exact congr rfl (funext fun i => ih i (by simp [hxs']))

--src: Mathlib.Data.Sum.Basic
@[simp]
theorem update_inr_comp_inl [DecidableEq (α ⊕ β)] {f : α ⊕ β → γ} {i : β} {x : γ} :
    update f (inr i) x ∘ inl = f ∘ inl :=
  (update_comp_eq_of_forall_ne _ _) fun _ ↦ inl_ne_inr

--src: Mathlib.Data.Option.Basic
theorem elim_none_some (f : Option α → β) : (fun x ↦ Option.elim x (f none) (f ∘ some)) = f :=
  funext fun o ↦ by cases o <;> rfl

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Pi.Basic
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem elim_one_mulSingle [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [One γ] (i : β) (c : γ) :
    Sum.elim (1 : α → γ) (Pi.mulSingle i c) = Pi.mulSingle (Sum.inr i) c := by
  simp only [Pi.mulSingle, Sum.elim_update_right, elim_one_one]

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Basic
@[simp]
theorem sumArrowEquivProdArrow_apply_fst {α β γ} (f : α ⊕ β → γ) (a : α) :
    (sumArrowEquivProdArrow α β γ f).1 a = f (inl a) :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Seq.Computation
@[simp] lemma liftRelAux_inl_inl {a : α} {b : β} :
  LiftRelAux R C (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inl b) = R a b := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Lattice
lemma iInter_sum {s : α ⊕ β → Set γ} : ⋂ x, s x = (⋂ x, s (.inl x)) ∩ ⋂ x, s (.inr x) := iInf_sum

C1_dependencies.name: Sum.elim
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- Define a function on `α ⊕ β` by giving separate definitions on `α` and `β`. -/
protected def elim {α β γ} (f : α → γ) (g : β → γ) : α ⊕ β → γ :=
  fun x => Sum.casesOn x f g
